Obodivka Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Vinnytska oblast, Ukraine

Not demolished. Obodivka was home to Yitzhak of Ozaryntsi, a tzaddik of the Chornobyl Hasidic dynasty, until his death from typhoid in December 1941. In November of that year, an extraordinary 10,000 Jews were brought to Obodivka's ghetto from Romania itself; many died of typhoid that winter, including Yitzhak of Ozaryntsi and the family of the rabbi of Boyan — another Hasidic dynasty documented elsewhere in this collection. Roughly 11,000 people were killed in Obodivka in total during the occupation.
